paragraphs: Consat Telematics is a Swedish provider of public transportation systems, founded in 1986 and operating across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Australia, Canada, and Brazil. The wider Consat group reports offices on five continents and more than 250 employees.

The transit offering is modular, covering electromobility for electric fleet monitoring and smart charging as well as traffic control and monitoring for real-time fleet oversight and incident management. Passenger information delivers accurate, real-time updates to riders both onboard and offboard. Every part is described as multivendor and multimodal compatible, deployable in cloud, on-premise, or data centre environments. Support runs end to end, from installation and integration through maintenance and training.

The hardware and software are installed on more than 40,000 vehicles globally. Named customers include Skyss in Norway, Tide Buss in Sweden, Ventura Bus Lines in Australia, and Din Tur in Sweden. A headline on the same page announces Bonnier Capital becoming a strategic partner in Consat Telematics. The company states that it is certified as a Great Place to Work for 2024 and 2025.
